rich_narrative.summary: Developments in Literacy (DIL) was founded in 1997 to deliver high-quality, low-cost education to underserved children in Pakistan, with a special focus on empowering young girls <cite id="16">through 214 operated schools</cite>. In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="3">$2,785,991 in total revenue</cite> while maintaining exceptional financial oversight. DIL directs <cite id="1">90.5% of its expenses to programs</cite>, matching the median peer ratio in global education and beating the 75% industry standard. The charity spent just <cite id="1">$0.05 per $1 raised</cite> on fundraising in FY2024, reflecting strong administrative discipline. DIL maintains a perfect <cite id="1">100.0/100 score from Charity Navigator</cite> and earns a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid. Verified outcome tracking demonstrates that <cite id="6">84% of students transition from primary to middle and middle to secondary school</cite>, while <cite id="6">79% of graduates proceed to higher education or vocational training</cite>. The organization's programs are zakat-eligible and serve student populations in critical need, making it an above-average choice for international education giving.
